text:
maria-ramirez: FYI AWS placed a hold on the 2026-03 invoice from ChannelPartnerX — portal shows 'unknown SKU/plan' and blocked payout. Anyone seen this?
aj: invoice ID?
maria-ramirez: INV-APAC-202603-9832. In portal the invoice line shows sku 'rdw-mkt-std-v2' but marketplace reports 'rdw-mkt-std-v2-chan' as the billed SKU.
billing-bot: Payment hold created by marketplace at 2026-03-05T14:22Z. Reason: SKU_NOT_FOUND.
samir-k: Is this a mapping problem from our reseller SKU map? I remember a tweak to channel suffix handling in Feb.
olivia: pulling mapping now... quick sample from partner file: 
```
sku, qty, unit_price
rdw-mkt-std-v2-chan, 120, 0.02
rdw-mkt-std-v2, 100, 0.025
```
maria-ramirez: We expected 100 seats at 0.025 but partner billed 120 at 0.02. Looks like both SKU mismatch and quantity diff. Need to reconcile usage and decide credit vs corrected invoice.
aj: Finance — can we provisionally credit to avoid collections/late fees while we sort this? We'll reverse if partner fixes it.
olivia: I'll ping the partner AM for their reconciliation report and ask for the PO/commitment they used. cc @samir-k.
samir-k: FYI if partner changed their internal banding and that changed unit price vs our committed tier, legal might need to check SOW/commitment language before we approve credits. @maria-ramirez can you attach the original commitment?
maria-ramirez: attached in thread (drive link): https://drive.redwood.com/drive/commitments/CPX-2025-comm.pdf
aj: provisional credit approved up to $3,000 pending partner confirmation and corrected invoice. Finance will flag for reversal if partner updates records.
billing-bot: Hold flag: MARKETPLACE_HOLD_SKU. Notifications sent to accounts-receivable and partner-ops.
olivia: partner AM replied: "we used an internal SKUPREFIX for partners, sending corrected reports and updated CSV now" — says corrected invoice will be submitted by EOD.
maria-ramirez: please confirm when marketplace releases the hold so payout can proceed.
aj: noted for month-end reconciliation. Thanks everyone.
